pages.title: Field Fix
pages.text: $(bold)Standard-issue goggles shattered at -80C, so field teams started wrapping salvaged fabric around glass panes.$()$(br2)Ugly, but functional.$(br2)The resulting lenses cut a little farther into phase-5 whiteout and stop your face from eating blown ice all day.

pages.title: Use Notes
pages.text: Wear them in a Curios $(thing)head$() slot for better visibility during phase 5 and early phase 6 blizzards. They extend whiteout visibility to about 32 blocks, then stop helping once the atmosphere starts thinning.$(br2)If you're also wearing an $(item)ORSA Thermal Visor$(), press $(thing)V$() for thermal and $(thing)B$() for blizzard optics.
Leather, salvage cloth, and enough glass to admit ORSA should have planned better.
